case_readability.instructions: Can a tester understand and review this displayed case on first reading without referring to internal records? Judge the displayed title, conditions, steps and expected results against the supplied source case.

criteria.true: The title names the main behavior; roles, conditions, ordered actions and observable results are concrete, concise and consistent. Each numbered item carries a clear thought, unnecessary setup details and repetition are removed, and the important source conditions and results remain identifiable.
criteria.false: The text uses long compound titles, repeated setup, unexplained internal labels, vague actions or results, or requires cross-referencing to understand the case. Compression omits a material role, condition, boundary, sequence or result. Do not reject a longer case solely because the source behavior is complex.

note_readability.instructions: Can a tester understand this pending issue and the requested decision on first reading without consulting internal IDs or files? Compare the displayed question and action with the supplied source issue.

criteria.true: The issue states the relevant business situation and a specific unresolved question in plain language. The action identifies what needs confirmation without presenting a guess as a decision. Its material meaning is preserved.
criteria.false: The issue relies on internal identifiers, file names, technical scoring or unexplained jargon; repeats background; leaves the question or requested decision unclear; omits the material context; or assumes an unconfirmed answer.
